subject: Kickoff: FY28 planning inputs — templates, scenarios, and timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: FY28 planning inputs — templates, scenarios, and timeline

Team —

Starting the FY28 planning sprint today. Goal: collect a single, comparable set of inputs from each function so Finance and GTM can build consolidated scenarios for the QBR and exec review. High-level asks: 

- Use the attached "annual_planning_input_template.xlsx" (tabbed by revenue, ops, headcount, product investments).
- Deliver three canonical scenarios: Base (most-likely), Downside (-20% growth vs base), Upside (+30% vs base). For each: revenue assumptions, major cost levers, and top 3 risks.
- Headcount: note hires vs reorgs and expected FTE ramp dates.
- Call-outs for any SLAs, Dedicated capacity, or large infra commitments requiring contracting or procurement involvement.

Deadline: please return completed template to this thread by EOD Monday, 17 May. If you need more time, flag here and include the blocker.

Attachments: annual_planning_input_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Deliverables will feed into the consolidated planning deck (linked in thread) and the QBR context packet. If you want Greenleaf to help model scenarios, CC them — I’ve looped them for visibility.

Thanks — let’s keep this lean. I will host an optional 30-min walkthrough tomorrow at 11:00 PT for anyone who wants a quick tour of the template.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Greenleaf Consulting <projects@greenleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: FY28 planning inputs — templates, scenarios, and timeline

Jonas — thanks. Ack and will populate Commercial/Revenue tab. A couple quick notes:

- We’ll provide ARR and net retention assumptions across Base/Downside/Upside and include new logo vs expansion split.
- Initial ask: revenue model will assume current pricing tiers; if Finance needs sensitivity by list vs discounted pricing, say so and we’ll include a second sheet.
- Attaching a short QBR context PDF from GTM (QBR_context_summary.pdf) with last-cycle outcomes and pending renewals that influence the Upside scenario.

I’ll aim for the 17 May deadline. If Greenleaf can run the consolidated topline scenario mapping while we finish inputs, that’d speed things up.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_context_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: FY28 planning inputs — templates, scenarios, and timeline

Jonas / team — quick ask: several product leads will be in offsite from 13–16 May and have limited bandwidth. Can we shift the internal input deadline to Wed, 19 May EOD? That will give Engineering/Product a couple extra days to finish headcount ramp dates and project phasing.

Also: We should call out any single-vendor procurement blockers early (e.g., on-prem infra or HSM procurement) so Legal/Procurement can start evaluating terms. I’ve CC’d Kimberly for procurement visibility.

If everyone is OK with 19 May, I’ll confirm and we’ll keep the 23–26 May window for small syncs to resolve cross-functional questions.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: FY28 planning inputs — templates, scenarios, and timeline

Thanks — noted and agreed. New deadline: Wed, 19 May EOD.

Action items (summary):
- All leads: complete attached template and return to this thread by 2027-05-19 EOD.
- Marissa: include revenue sensitivity sheet if Finance requests list vs discounted pricing.
- Laura/Kimberly: flag any procurement/legal blockers in your submission (add short note in the "risks/constraints" column).
- Soojin/Vivek: if there are material SLA or Dedicated/Private deployment asks that change cost profile, escalate to Vivek and Soojin before the 19th.
- Jonas (me): collect, run a quick reconciliation pass 20–21 May, and circulate a consolidated scenario deck to Execs by 23 May.

Optional walkthrough tomorrow 11:00 PT remains on calendar — please join if you want the template tour.

If anyone is blocked earlier, ping me or escalate to Vivek.

Jonas
Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
